$note: Applied as the final character pass of Simplified -> Traditional, so 裏 becomes 裡 and 麪 becomes 麵. These 41 entries are pinned in the project on purpose instead of being read from OpenCC at build time: the step decides which glyph a reader sees, so a change should show up as a reviewable diff here rather than as a silent upstream edit. Edit this file, then run node scripts/build-s2t.js.
